notes.title: Hot Squat 2: New Glory is now FREE (and so are all our games)
notes.content:
Hot Squat 2: New Glory. the revolutionary sequel to Hot Squat, is now free. Nothing about the game is changing, it's just free now. So if you like Hot Squat, you'd probably like Hot Squat 2 as well, it has a lot more features than Hot Squat 1.

Also our minimalist VR puzzle game UNTITLED is free now too, so if you're into puzzle games check them out :)

In fact, all of our games our free now, so check out Turner too, it goes kinda hard.

Love,
- Bean Enthusiast Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - Hot Fix 1.03
notes.content:
Sup summertime squatters, just because it's hot outside doesn't mean you get a rest day! We've added the ability to turn off the in game music so you can bump to your own jams! Just press the menu button located above the trackpad to mute the in game audio. Have fun sweating and squatting!

- Added ability to mute in game audio by pressing the menu button located above the trackpad.



Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat – UNTITLED Update
notes.content:
Sup squatters! We’re very excited to announce that we have just released our new virtual reality game, UNTITLED. It’s a physics based puzzle game that will test your mind and invigorate your sense of discovery. I’ve always said, the strongest muscle in your body is your brain, so why not make major gains there too? In celebration of the games release, we’ve done a complete makeover to Hot Squat to match the theme of our new release! So whether or not your check out our new game or not, we hope you enjoy getting huge in the new remodeled Flynn Fitness Gym! Happy squatting!

-    Added a temporary visual makeover to Hot Squat in the theme of our new game!

Check out UNTITLED here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/639770/UNTITLED/

Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - New Year, New You
notes.content:
It's the new year. What's your resolution this year? Ours is to GET HUGE. If you share this resolution, what better way to fulfill it than to play Hot Squat! Tired of all the new years gym bags? Gym too full? Then work out in your own home with Hot Squat! With new achievements just in time for the new year, there's no better time than now. New year, new you...we'll see you at the gym.

- Added 4 new achievements

Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - Holiday Update
notes.content:
It’s the holiday season, there’s no better time to stoke the fire, brew some hot tea, and cuddle up in bed with a good book right? WRONG. Your gains don’t take a holiday break, and neither should you! That’s why we’re releasing the Hot Squat Christmas Update, adding Christmas spirit and decorations to the gym. Now you can celebrate the holidays where you should be, at the gym getting huge! It’s time to deck the halls with lots of squatting, we’ll see you at the gym.

- Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - Hot Fix 1.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We realize that there are many players who are confused on what the green/red box in front of them is, so we released a patch that should make this more obvious! We're loving the support we're getting from everyone! We are sorry that we did not make it clear enough what the box was for! Hopefully after this patch, it should be crystal clear that you are supposed to keep your hands inside the box, otherwise the round will end! Thanks again to all of our fans, we couldn't be more appreciative!

- Added a message stating "Put your hands back inside the box" whenever your hands leave the box.

Keep on squatting,
Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - Hot Fix 1.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are rolling out a quick hot fix to address the problems that some people were having dealing with their hand placement and the walls exploding. In this hot fix, we made the box where you are supposed to keep your hands more visible and we also made it so if your hands are a little bit outside of the box it won't start counting down to a game over. Along with this, we have changed the time allowed outside the box from 3 seconds to 4 seconds to be more forgiving if you are really getting into it and forget to keep your hands in the right place.

Thank you all so much for playing, leaving reviews, communicating on the discussion board, and reaching out to us through other means. We are very happy you all like the game!

- Made the box where you are supposed to keep your hands more visible.
- Made it so if your hands are a little bit outside of the box it won't start counting down to a game over.
- Changed the time allowed outside the box from 3 seconds to 4 seconds to be more forgiving if you are really getting into it and forget to keep your hands in the right place.

Keep squatting,
Bean Boy Games
